excerpts.text:
The correct order for the eight official planets in our solar system, from
closest to farthest from the Sun, is (a) Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Saturn,
Jupiter, Neptune, Uranus; (b) Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Uranus,
Neptune, Saturn; (c) Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus,
Neptune.
